name: muse_spark_moe_shuffled_16x16_model_dim4096_topk8_n_experts32_inter_dim4096_global_experts257
description: vLLM's MuseSpark1xMoE experts on one expert-parallel rank with MXFP4 experts, from the pooled rows to the unweighted output of each route: each row's pre-expert RMSNorm (fp32, times norm_weight + gain_center), then per route, the routes to the experts expert_mask gives this rank, down(silu(gate(x)) * up(x)) of its MXFP4 weights (fused_moe's: fp4 values at an e8m0 scale per 32); the routes to the others write zeros. The router weights, the post-expert norm and the sum over the routes are vLLM's, after it.

model_dim.description: The pooled width: the experts' hidden size.

n_experts.description: Experts this rank holds: w1's and w2's.

global_experts.description: expert_mask's length: the group's routed experts, then vLLM's always-masked slot.

gate_up_rows.description: w1 rows: gate and up concatenated.

hidden_states.description: The pooled rows, not yet normalized.

norm_weight.description: The pre-expert RMSNorm's gain, before gain_center is added.

topk_ids.description: Each row's routed experts, distinct within a row: global ids.

expert_mask.description: 1 for the experts this rank holds, in the order w1 holds them; 0 in the last slot.

w1.description: Gate-up projection per expert: gate rows, then up rows.

gain_center.description: Added to norm_weight: 1 for a zero-centered gain.

out.description: Each route's expert output, unweighted; zeros off this rank.
